- Platform document numbers: local D01-D12 are the task page's Doc 1-12 in the same order, so "Doc N" in the reasoning equals local Dnn.
- Family and target: match then exclude over ten quarter-to-quarter balance comparisons (total debt down, net debt up), written after the platform measured event-defined-quarter lookups as too easy (q01-q04). Target easy; measured platform result pending. Sketch from the round-3 question-author (i10), verified by caller script.
- Dependency plan: quarter-end balances (total debt; net debt / adjusted debt) at 4Q23 20,836 / 12,613; 1Q24 21,835 / 15,557; 2Q24 23,184 / 19,176; 3Q24 25,841 / 21,138; 4Q24 24,541 / 17,756; 1Q25 29,681 / 25,038; 2Q25 29,467 / 25,401; 3Q25 41,544 / 33,817; 4Q25 40,758 / 34,461; 1Q26 45,428 / 40,101; 2Q26 37,075 / 28,545. - Universe: the ten quarters 1Q 2024 through 2Q 2026; each is tested in Steps 2-11. Exclusions: eight quarters where total debt rose or both measures fell.
- Necessity: each non-December quarter-end balance is printed only in its own release (Attachment 2 compares the quarter-end with the previous December 31): March 31, 2024 (D02), June 30, 2024 (D03), September 30, 2024 (D04), March 31, 2025 (D06), June 30, 2025 (D08), September 30, 2025 (D09), March 31, 2026 (D11), June 30, 2026 (D12). December balances repeat in later releases (December 31, 2023 in D01-D05; December 31, 2024 in D05, D06, D08-D10; December 31, 2025 in D10-D12), so D01, D05 and D10 are not listed. Cash-flow lines (net change in debt, net change in cash including restricted cash) approximate flows, not the balances, and printed debt and net debt ratios are rounded ratios that do not determine the balance changes.
- Selected-lever checks: Match, then exclude: without the net-debt condition the list is 4Q 2024, 2Q 2025, 4Q 2025, 2Q 2026 (both 4Q 2024 and 2Q 2026 cut total debt but also cut net debt; 2Q 2026 is D12's "record $8.4 billion" reduction). Comparing each release's own two columns (quarter-end vs the previous December) instead of consecutive quarter-ends gives no qualifying quarter. Using the printed debt-ratio and net-debt-ratio rows as proxies gives 4Q 2025 only (author's check).

- Semantic/ID/overview probes: no passage states a quarter-to-quarter net debt change; the overview prints only the 2Q 2026 "$8.4 billion total debt reduction" (a decoy).
- Precision/readings: single stated balances in $ millions; definitions: D01-D03 "Adjusted debt" omits time deposits from its label (none reported then; D04 onward include them), and values at shared dates agree across editions.

Chevron's fiscal year is the calendar year, so "1Q 2024" and "2Q 2026" need no fiscal label. sections.question: From 1Q 2024 through 2Q 2026, in which quarters, if any, did Chevron's total debt fall while its net debt (total debt minus cash, cash equivalents, time deposits and marketable securities) rose, compared with the previous quarter-end? List them in date order.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 8, Doc 9, Doc 11 and Doc 12 label the measure "Net debt (Total debt less cash and cash equivalents, time deposits and marketable securities)"; Doc 2, Doc 3, Doc 4 and Doc 6 print the same quantity as "Adjusted debt". Each release's balance sheet compares its own quarter-end with the previous December 31, so the previous quarter-end usually comes from the prior release.

Step 2. Doc 2: total debt rose from 20,836 at December 31, 2023 to 21,835 at March 31, 2024, so 1Q 2024 does not qualify.

Step 3. Doc 2 and Doc 3: total debt rose from 21,835 at March 31, 2024 to 23,184 at June 30, 2024, so 2Q 2024 does not qualify.

Step 4. Doc 3 and Doc 4: total debt rose from 23,184 at June 30, 2024 to 25,841 at September 30, 2024, so 3Q 2024 does not qualify.

Step 5. Doc 4 and Doc 6: total debt fell from 25,841 at September 30, 2024 to 24,541 at December 31, 2024, but net debt (adjusted debt) also fell, from 21,138 to 17,756, so 4Q 2024 does not qualify.

Step 6. Doc 6: total debt rose from 24,541 at December 31, 2024 to 29,681 at March 31, 2025, so 1Q 2025 does not qualify.

Step 7. Doc 6 and Doc 8: total debt fell from 29,681 at March 31, 2025 to 29,467 at June 30, 2025, while net debt rose from 25,038 (adjusted debt) to 25,401, so 2Q 2025 qualifies.

Step 8. Doc 8 and Doc 9: total debt rose from 29,467 at June 30, 2025 to 41,544 at September 30, 2025, so 3Q 2025 does not qualify.

Step 9. Doc 9 and Doc 11: total debt fell from 41,544 at September 30, 2025 to 40,758 at December 31, 2025, while net debt rose from 33,817 to 34,461, so 4Q 2025 qualifies.

Step 10. Doc 11: total debt rose from 40,758 at December 31, 2025 to 45,428 at March 31, 2026, so 1Q 2026 does not qualify.

Step 11. Doc 11 and Doc 12: total debt fell from 45,428 at March 31, 2026 to 37,075 at June 30, 2026, but net debt also fell, from 40,101 to 28,545, so 2Q 2026 does not qualify.

Step 12. The qualifying quarters in date order are 2Q 2025 and 4Q 2025.
